facts.text: Last Tuesday — Sora was 20 minutes late.
Witness report — mumbles in full sentences.

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: Sora
sets.text: Late again, {player_name}?{w0.5} [i]Always[/i] the same with you.

sets.speaker: N2
sets.name: Jin
sets.text: [b]I can explain![/b]{w0.6} There was the bus, and then...{w0.6} [color=#ff7f50]the bus again[/color]?

sets.speaker: N1
sets.name: Sora
sets.text: You always say that.{w0.4} Last week it was the bus, the week before that your alarm clock, and the week before that you forgot we were meeting at all. So tell me — what is it this time?

response.speaker: N1
response.name: Sora
response.text: [i]Knew it.[/i] At least you're honest today.

choices.text: It really was the bus this time!

response.speaker: N1
response.name: Sora
response.text: Mm-hm. That's what you said last week, too.

choices.text: Fact check: my bus app says 7:42.

response.speaker: N1
response.name: Sora
response.text: [fade start=1 length=6]You screenshotted the bus app.[/fade] Of course you did.
